description: Check whether one domain name is free to register. Answers from the public registry for that ending: available, unavailable (taken) or unknown (that ending cannot be checked here). Takes one full name such as yourbrand.com.ng. When it can be ordered online, gives the first-year price. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

domain.description: One full domain name, for example yourbrand.com.ng.

name: check_domain_availability
